$comment: D-LK-ARCHIVE-SEARCH-FETCHES-A-MEMBER-FOR-A-WEAK-REFERENCE (P69 round 5, lane lm): a WEAK reference to a C library function binds on every format. `strtol` is a body DSS ships on pe and Mach-O and libc.so.6's on ELF; `memset_explicit` (C23 7.26.6.2) is a body DSS ships on every format. A name whose body the platform states DSS ships as source (a descriptor's `realization.<format>`) answers a weak reference as a name the platform's own image exports does: the archive search fetches the runtime's member for it whatever the members' document says of an operator's archive (`pullStaticArchiveMembers`, the weak round's question to the corpus). 42 = both names bound and called; 1 = `strtol` read as NULL, 2 = it did not convert, 3 = `memset_explicit` read as NULL. MEASURED 2026-10-08 (probe-reference-cc, lane lm): glibc 2.39 through gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 on x86_64 (WSL run 20261008-124124-f2e03cd4) and gcc on aarch64 (VPS run 20261008-124216-13d4cb48), and libSystem through Apple clang 21 on arm64 and x86_64 (Mac run 20261008-124259-d1b23e87), bind a weak reference to `strtol` and call it on their default link; MinGW gcc 13.2.0 + GNU ld's PE linker answer 1 for it (the weak external asks no library search and the UCRT's import library is an archive; Windows run 20261008-124341-767eb80d), and cl has no spelling for the declaration — the fork DSS decides for the platform's default link. BEFORE round 5 the search treated DSS's runtime archive as an operator's: pe returned 1, ELF 3. RED-ON-DISABLE: drop the weak round's question to the corpus -> the pe arm returns 1 and the two ELF arms 3, while the Mach-O arms (whose members' document fetches for every weak reference) stay 42, the control. THE EXAMPLE'S OWN FILE ON THE REFERENCES (MEASURED 2026-10-08, probe-reference-cc; WSL run 20261008-145211-8c845c0a, VPS 20261008-145235-184527d2, Mac 20261008-145256-c2ad4ac8, Windows 20261008-145314-62d34279): none of them returns 42, each for its own library's reason -- glibc 2.39 (gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 on x86_64, gcc on aarch64) returns 3: `strtol` binds to libc.so and `memset_explicit` is not in that glibc, so the weak reference is null; Apple clang 21 REFUSES the link (Undefined symbols: `_memset_explicit` -- a weak reference to a name libSystem lacks is a link error there); mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 + GNU ld PE returns 1: the CALLED weak `strtol` is a weak external that asks no library search, and the UCRT's import library is an archive. DSS returns 42 on all five, on the orchestrator's DECISION of 2026-10-08 that DSS's runtime IS the platform's library to a program -- that difference is the decision's stated cost, not a defect of this example.
